---
title: "Author requested supplementary figure merges"
format: html
---

Display-only assembly from retained 16S and current catalogue sources. Argument 2
is `consecutive` only after author confirmation; otherwise original labels are
retained for the merged-page preview. No statistical reanalysis.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import io, json, sys, subprocess, hashlib, re
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter, Transformation
from pypdf.generic import TextStringObject
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont
from PIL import Image

root=Path('/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived')
out=Path(sys.argv[1]);out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
consecutive=len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='consecutive'
src=Path('manuscript/supplementary_review_2026-09-22.qmd').read_text().split('```{python}\n')[1].split('\n```')[0]
env={'__name__':'assembly_sources','sys':sys}
# Collect the nine existing captions and their sources without running the legacy
# assembly or modifying its outputs. Its source checks and table remapping apply.
prefix=src[:src.index('out = Path(sys.argv[1])')]
exec(prefix,env)
env.update(out=out)
mid=src[src.index("snap = d/"):src.index('# Verify the unchanged')]
exec(mid,env)
items=[]
def collect(title,body='',source=None,draw=None):
    i=len(items);body=env['remap_table_refs'](body)
    if i==0: body=re.sub(r'^'+re.escape(env['caption_titles'][0])+r'\.\s*','',body.strip())
    items.append(dict(title=env['caption_titles'][i],body=body,source=source,draw=draw))
env['page']=collect
exec(src[src.index('# Verify the unchanged'):src.index("s1=d/'community_cross_omics_permutation")],env)
assert len(items)==9
items[2]['source']=root/'supplementary_votu_compact_2026-09-23-v1/votu-realm-composition.pdf'

pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('MergeSans','/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'))
pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont('MergeBold','/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf'))
pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily('MergeSans',normal='MergeSans',bold='MergeBold',italic='MergeSans',boldItalic='MergeBold')
style=ParagraphStyle('Caption',fontName='MergeSans',fontSize=10,leading=13)
W,H=595.28,841.89
buffer=io.BytesIO();c=canvas.Canvas(buffer,pagesize=(W,H)); provenance=[]
def raster(path):
    path=Path(path); digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    dst=out/(path.stem+'-display.pdf')
    reader=PdfReader(path);p=reader.pages[0];stream=p.get_contents();changes=0
    for operands,operator in stream.operations:
        if operator==b'Tj' and str(operands[0])=='Phage-UV':
            operands[0]=TextStringObject('Treatment');changes+=1
    if changes:p.replace_contents(stream)
    writer=PdfWriter();writer.add_page(p)
    with dst.open('wb') as f:writer.write(f)
    png=dst.with_suffix('')
    subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-singlefile','-r','300','-png',str(dst),str(png)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    provenance.append({'source':str(path),'sha256':digest,'display_label_replacements':changes})
    return str(png)+'.png',float(p.mediabox.width),float(p.mediabox.height)
def art(path,x,top,maxw,maxh,letter=None):
    png,w,h=raster(path);s=min(maxw/w,maxh/h)
    c.drawImage(png,x+(maxw-w*s)/2,top-h*s,width=w*s,height=h*s)
    if letter:c.setFont('MergeBold',11);c.drawString(x,top+4,letter)
    return top-h*s
def caption(number,title,body,top):
    body=re.sub(r'\b([A-D])\)',r'<b>\1)</b>',body)
    p=Paragraph(f'<b>Figure S{number}: {title}.</b> '+body,style)
    _,h=p.wrap(W-72,750)
    assert top-h>=36,(number,top,h)
    p.drawOn(c,36,top-h)
    c.setFont('MergeSans',8);c.drawString(36,22,'Supplementary figures');c.drawRightString(W-36,22,str(number));c.showPage()

groups=[(0,),(3,2),(1,),(4,5),(6,),(7,),(8,)]
numbers=list(range(1,8)) if consecutive else [1,2,4,5,7,8,9]
for number,group in zip(numbers,groups):
    if group==(3,2):
        y=art(root/'supplementary_composition_aligned_2026-09-23-v3/aligned-composition.pdf',36,800,W-72,620)
        body=('A) Family-level relative abundances from 16S rRNA-derived cDNA across 12 samples. '
              'Other classified families and sequences unclassified at family level remain separate. '
              'B) Viral realm composition of all 634 abundance-eligible vOTUs, expressed as shares of vOTU-mapped metagenomic reads. '
              'Bars sum to 100% within each sample; unclassified sequences remain in the denominator. '
              'Control and treatment are aligned by cycle and sampling phase (I, initial; BF, backflush). '
              'Viral catalogue quality and taxonomy are reported in Supplementary Table S3.')
        caption(number,'Amplicon and viral community composition across cleaning cycles',body,y-14)
    elif group==(4,5):
        y1=art(root/'supplementary_ordination_pair_2026-09-23-v2/paired-ordinations.pdf',36,800,W-72,330)
        y2=y1
        body=('Principal-coordinate analyses of 16S rRNA amplicon sequence variant profiles from 12 samples using '
              'A) Bray-Curtis dissimilarities and B) Aitchison distances. Axes 1 and 2 explain 45.1% and 17.4% '
              'of variation for Bray-Curtis and 29.2% and 15.9% for Aitchison, respectively. '
              'Colours identify control and treatment; circles and triangles identify initial and backflush samples. '
              'Numbers identify cleaning cycles. PERMANOVA results are reported in Supplementary Table S26.')
        caption(number,'16S rRNA community structure under two distance measures',body,min(y1,y2)-20)
    else:
        it=items[group[0]]
        if it['draw']:
            it['draw'](c);top=170
        else:top=art(it['source'],36,H-36,W-72,490)-15
        caption(number,it['title'],it['body'],top)
c.save();pdf=out/'Supplementary_Figures.pdf';pdf.write_bytes(buffer.getvalue())
assert len(PdfReader(pdf).pages)==7
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'consecutive_numbering':consecutive,'display_numbers':numbers,'groups_old':[ [1],[2,3],[4],[5,6],[7],[8],[9]],'sources':provenance,'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pdf.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
print(pdf)
```
